evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 14 / Excel row 15 requires self-consistent synthetic seed data without orphan references or injection payloads. Its internal annotation and skill check 14 specifically forbid credentials in the seed; the public demo password is separately documented and no password/token/secret field is present in either seed. Manual reading of every seed field found seven @hireops.example accounts, fictional roster names and business figures, no real contact/location/financial account details, no live secret, and no instruction-bearing injection. The descriptive generated_note at environment/assets/seed_data.json:2 is ordinary input documentation, not grader instructions. Ran python -B qc/runs/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/per-row-review/evidence/14/check_seed.py successfully. Its saved result records three parsed shipped JSON files, byte-identical seed copies (SHA256 1b39015461a7a4f23b835aeea9584caffd0266c64d394778376cbd6c8a18bcf7), 3 employees, 7 users, 7 requisitions, 13 offers, 8 commitments, 1 equity grant, 2 signing payments and 2 referrals. All 51 non-null foreign references resolve; entity IDs/emails are unique; 32 UTC instants parse; committed offer authority, exact commitment amounts, grant terms/dates, signing totals, referral identities and child-record completeness agree. Every headroom remains nonnegative; no seed check failed. The planning scalars intentionally differ: REQ-ENG-1 has 25,000,000 stored planning cents but 60,000,000 - 15,000,000 - 21,000,000 = 24,000,000 live cents (seed:93-97,385-392). This is consistent with public hireops_rules.md:91-95 and 178-193, which explicitly identifies these old scalars as stale and non-authoritative. A broken app trusting the scalar would show incorrect headroom; this is an app defect, not an orphan/inconsistent authoritative seed, and functional judge.toml:470 requires netting fresh movement rows. Conforming alternative assessed: omit all six optional operational arrays while retaining users/employees/constants/clock. instruction.md and rules:91-95 permit this; tests/app_context.md and functional prompt P9/P10 tolerate it. The actual local/batch-witnesses.cjs:13-17 mutation clears those arrays; its empty_operational_seed/results.json reports 15 passing local HTTP groups, with all four recorded source-module hashes matching this frozen candidate.
